svg.title: Legacy and SegWit transaction structure
svg.desc: A legacy transaction has version, input count, inputs, output count, outputs, and locktime, with the signatures inside the inputs, and its txid hashes every field. A SegWit transaction adds a marker 0x00 and flag 0x01 after the version and a witness structure before the locktime, which now holds the signatures. Its txid hashes everything except marker, flag, and witness structure, while its wtxid hashes every field.

text.tspan: txid = hash of every field, signatures included
txid = hash of everything except marker, flag, and witness structure
